nl: 仓储货位管理，单文件组件模式：查询有货位编码；表格展示货位编码、库区、容量、使用率；支持新增、编辑、删除。后端分页用的页码字段叫 pageIndex（不是默认的 pageNo）。
nlEn: Storage bin management in single-file-component mode: query by bin code; the table shows bin code, zone, capacity, and usage rate; supports add, edit, and delete. The backend paging page-number field is named pageIndex (not the default pageNo).
notes: AI-08: single-key override (current only) in SFC mode (vue3/sfc)
